text:
Renee Carter: Heads-up: I opened a small PR to tidy function-calling docs and unify examples across languages. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 :sparkles:
Amit Shah: Thanks Renee. What changed exactly? I saw a failing snippet job in CI.
Renee Carter: Main changes: 1) swap examples to the explicit action+args shape for readability, 2) move compact envelope to an "Advanced" collapsible section, 3) fix two broken anchors to the canonical schema, 4) add a tiny "If the model returns non-JSON" fallback pattern.
Kara O'Neill: Nice. Can we keep the inline schema minimal and avoid pasting the full JSONSchema? Link to /docs/schema-toolcall.md instead.
Renee Carter: Yep, minimal inline example only. Example shown in docs (language fences included):

```python
# minimal example (explicit action + args)
resp = client.invoke_tool(
    model="redwood-1",
    input="Summarize the notes",
    tools=[{"name":"summarize","args":{"max_len":120}}]
)
print(resp.json())
```

Kara O'Neill: Good. For the "If the model returns non-JSON" section I suggested a balanced-brace extractor rather than a greedy regex. Small snippet is fine.
Amit Shah: Agreed. Minimal Python helper like find_first_json() is fine; add a JS equivalent. Also call out edge cases: multiple JSON blobs and arrays as top-level responses.
Ethan Wu: Quick nit: avoid language like "model must emit JSON". Use "Prefer structured JSON output; fallbacks are provided when necessary." Keeps tone softer for public docs.
Renee Carter: Done. Wording updated in PR. I also added a one-line checklist for docs authors at the bottom: 1) prefer explicit action/args in main examples, 2) put compact envelope only in Advanced, 3) link to canonical schema, 4) include fallback snippet only under "If non-JSON", 5) run snippet-ci locally.
docs-bot: snippet-ci reported: python-snippets: 1 failed (missing language fence), js-snippets: 0 failed. Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/snippet/5123
Amit Shah: The failing python snippet is probably a fenced block without ```python. I can patch that quickly.
Kara O'Neill: I'll push the JS readability tweak (rename variable to 'resp_text') and add a brief note about using the streaming JSON parser when available.
Ethan Wu: I pushed a tiny example for Go showing the same action/args pattern so cross-language readers see parity.
Renee Carter: Thanks all. Once the small fixes land I'll re-run snippet-ci and merge if green. I'll also add a changelog bullet linking to the PR and mention the author credits. Ping me for a quick review before merge. :white_check_mark:
